Command `cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzz.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":36,"var":"data,size","code":"mg_mqtt_parse(data, size, 0, &mm);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are passed directly into the MQTT parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3254,"var":"buf[0]","code":"m->cmd = (uint8_t)(buf[0] >> 4);","note":"The first byte is interpreted as the MQTT command; 0x30 selects PUBLISH."},
  {"step":3,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3258,"var":"p","code":"p = (uint8_t *) buf + 1;","note":"Parsing advances to the remaining-length field immediately after the fixed header."},
  {"step":4,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3259,"var":"lc","code":"lc = *((uint8_t *) p++);","note":"The parser reads the first remaining-length byte from attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":5,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3260,"var":"n","code":"n += (uint32_t)((lc & 0x7f) << 7 * len_len);","note":"Because the byte has the continuation bit set, the parser expects more length bytes and accumulates the decoded size."},
  {"step":6,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3262,"var":"len_len","code":"if (len_len >= 4) return MQTT_MALFORMED;","note":"The loop only stops after up to four bytes, so a truncated varint can leave the parser positioned at the end of the buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3265,"var":"end","code":"end = p + n;","note":"The computed message end depends on the attacker-controlled remaining-length value."},
  {"step":8,"file":"mongoose.c","function":"mg_mqtt_parse","line":3266,"var":"lc,end","code":"if ((lc & 0x80) || (end > buf + len)) return MQTT_INCOMPLETE;","note":"With a truncated input like 0x30 0x81, the parser returns incomplete after having already dereferenced the out-of-bounds length byte."}
]
